ai.title: AI-driven polymer discovery could replace years of trial and error with closed-loop testing
ai.description: In the realm of materials science, there is a plethora of datasets and tools at our disposal—the issue is how to effectively use these resources in harmony. Researchers at the Advanced Institute for Materials Research (WPI-AIMR), Tohoku University, have identified major bottlenecks holding back artificial intelligence-driven polymer innovation and created a system that integrates multiple tools (such as polymer databases, predictive models, AI agents and automated laboratories).
ai.title_cn: 人工智能驱动的聚合物发现可以用闭环测试取代多年的试错
ai.description_cn: 在材料科学领域，我们可以使用大量的数据集和工具-问题是如何有效地和谐地使用这些资源。东北大学材料研究高级研究所（WPI-AIMR）的研究人员确定了阻碍人工智能驱动的聚合物创新的主要瓶颈，并创建了一个集成多种工具（例如聚合物数据库、预测模型、人工智能代理和自动化实验室）的系统。
